header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: I have entrusted to You. Fearing You and longing for You, I have sought Your help. There is no place of refuge and no place of salvation other than You. I have believed in the Book You sent down. And I have also believed in the Prophet You sent' — recite this Du'a” — Hazrat Bara' ibn Azib (RA) says that the Prophet ﷺ told him this. (After reciting this Du'a and going to sleep) if you die that night, you will have died upon Islam. If you wake up in the morning, you will receive great good. After this Du'a do not speak about anything else, (go to sleep)” the Prophet ﷺ said. Hazrat Bara' (RA) says, “I began to memorise this Du'a in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ. (In the last sentence) instead of (وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ) I said (وَبِرَسُولِكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ). The Prophet ﷺ said, “Not like that”, say (وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ)!

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: إِذَا أَوَي أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَي فِرَاشِهِ فَلْيَنْفُضْ فِرَاشَهُ بِدَاخِلَةِ إِزَارِهِ فَإِنَّهُ لَايَدْرِي مَاخَلَفَهُ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “When any of you goes to his bed, let him shake out the bed three times with his lungi. For he does not know what came onto the bed while he was away. (While he was away some venomous creature may have come and hidden in his bed) After that, (بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ) “O my Lord! Saying Your name I have laid my side on the bed. With Your name I will lift it from the bed.
